node_relevance_reason: Cross-species snRNA-seq of amygdala identifying cell groups by subnucleus (BLA, CEA, IA, COA/MEA, PL). Covers IA TSHZ1+ neurons (DRD1+ and DRD1-), CEA Prkcd/Sst/Tac2/Drd2 neurons, paralaminar (PL) neurons. Directly covers intercalated_cell_mass_neuron, cea_pkc_delta_neuron, paralaminar_immature_neuron.
summary: snRNA-seq of 200,000+ amygdala nuclei from humans, macaques, mice, and chickens identified CEA, IA, BLA, COA/MEA, and PL cell groups. IA neurons contain two TSHZ1+ types (DRD1+ and DRD1−). CEA and IA inhibitory neurons were most evolutionarily conserved. Paralaminar (PL) neurons express immature markers (SOX11, BCL2) and are expanded in primates.
quotes: the IA subnuclei were highly conserved, and all mammals in our datasets contained two types of TSHZ1+ neurons, i.e., DRD1+ and DRD1−.
humans and macaques contained a neuronal cluster with high expression of immature markers, such as SOX11 and BCL2, which were likely derived from the PL

LAMP5+ interneurons were much more abundant in primates, while DRD2+ inhibitory neurons and LAMP5+SATB2+ excitatory neurons were dominant in the human central amygdalar nucleus (CEA) and basolateral amygdalar complex (BLA)

source_title: Single-nucleus genomics in outbred rats with divergent cocaine addiction-like behaviors reveals changes in amygdala GABAergic inhibition
node_relevance_reason: Provides rat amygdala snRNA-seq atlas identifying cell types including inhibitory neuron subtypes in CeA. CCK+/VIP+ and NOS1+ inhibitory neuron subtypes implicated in GABAergic synapse pathway. Relevant to bla_cck_basket_cell, bla_vip_calretinin_interneuron, bla_gabaergic_projection_neuron.
summary: Single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of rat amygdala identified excitatory and inhibitory cell types including 7 inhibitory neuron subtypes. High cocaine addiction index rats showed increased GABAergic transmission in CeA. Pathway enrichment suggests GABAergic synapse-related genes specific to CCK+/VIP+ and NOS1+ inhibitory neuron subtypes.
quotes: we identified seven subtypes of inhibitory neurons based on the expression of known cell marker genes
the pathway enrichment analysis of the transcriptomic data suggest that GABAergic synapse-related genes may be specific to Cck+/Vip+ and Nos1+ subtypes of inhibitory neurons

source_title: Transcriptomic Analysis Corroborates the New Radial Model of the Mouse Pallial Amygdala
node_relevance_reason: Transcriptomic analysis supporting radial model of pallial (glutamatergic) amygdala with Slc17a6/Slc17a7 differential expression. Relevant to bla_glutamatergic_principal_neuron and mea_glutamatergic_projection_neuron.
summary: snRNA-seq of mouse amygdala reveals two super-radial domains in the pallial amygdala distinguished by Slc17a6 vs Slc17a7 expression. The Slc17a6-expressing domain is more similar to subpallial output regions, while the Slc17a7 domain is more akin to cortical areas. Four main radial progenitor domains are supported.
quotes: at low resolution, the whole pallial amygdala was found to divide into two super-radial domains distinguished by differential expression of Slc17a6 and Slc17a7; the former partly imitates molecularly the subpallial (output) amygdalar regions
